title: Fetus
notes: Embryonic science-fiction songs merge melodic folk fragments, VCS3 electronics, violin and audio collage.

title: Pollution
notes: Dense progressive-rock interplay, distorted electronics, backwards passages and environmental anxiety.

title: Sulle corde di Aries
notes: Four slowly evolving suites connect electronic repetition, layered singing and unusual acoustic instrumentation.

title: Clic
notes: Largely instrumental electronics, string quartet, reversed vocals and radio fragments dedicated to Stockhausen.

title: M.elle le “Gladiator”
notes: Radio fragments and dissonant tape collage alternate with cathedral-organ improvisations.

title: Battiato
notes: Percussive piano repetition yields to fractured spoken fragments and soprano-led collage.

title: Juke Box
notes: Rejected documentary score juxtaposes solo violin, soprano, Latin prayer and tense chamber arrangements.

title: L’Egitto prima delle sabbie
notes: Two piano pieces explore repeated notes, silences, resonances and meditative acoustic decay.

title: L’era del cinghiale bianco
notes: Ornate violin hooks and crisp rock rhythms frame esoteric pop and Sicilian longing.

title: Patriots
notes: Brittle synthesizers and violin accompany anthems, multilingual fragments and sharp cultural satire.

title: La voce del padrone
scene: Italian new wave / sophisticated synth pop
notes: Seven compact pop songs unite synth textures, choral counterpoint, philosophical allusions and danceable hooks.

title: L’arca di Noè
notes: Apocalyptic choruses and stark synth-pop contrast with dance rhythms and pointed social criticism.

title: Orizzonti perduti
notes: Sparse sequenced pop balances urban alienation, homeward nostalgia and restrained electronic arrangements.

title: Mondi lontanissimi
notes: Cosmic imagery and intimate songs pair glossy synthesizers with orchestral and acoustic detail.

title: Genesi
scene: Italian contemporary opera / electronic-acoustic music theatre
notes: First opera interlaces staged myth, massed chorus, symphonic playing and programmed sound.

title: Nómadas
notes: Spanish re-recordings of 1979-85 synth new-wave songs, plus Camisasca’s new title track.

title: Fisiognomica
notes: Orchestral songs weave restrained electronics, Sicilian memory, sacred searching and intimate longing.

title: Come un cammello in una grondaia
notes: Four original meditations and four reworked lieder replace pop rhythm with chamber austerity.

title: Gilgamesh
scene: Italian contemporary opera / spiritual music theatre
notes: Mythic two-act opera pairs voices, orchestra and computers in studio-recorded ritual drama.

title: Caffè de la Paix
notes: Mediterranean songs braid Arabic and Indian timbres with rock players and chamber arrangements.
